solution_criteria: Meal plan spans exactly 1 day with 3-4 meals/snacks
Carbohydrates comprise 60-65% of total daily calories
Total daily calories align with the 3,000-3,500 calorie goal

task_description: Write a compact, concise 1 day meal plan for a single athlete

solution_criteria: Meal plan contains exactly 3 meals (breakfast, lunch, dinner) covering 1 full day
